verdict.rationale: Linear is an issue tracker with customer-request intake, so an embeddable feedback widget is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows intake through integrations (Slack, Intercom, Front), manual customer creation and the GraphQL API. Nothing documents a website-embeddable widget loaded via a single script tag without a build step.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed a feedback widget on my website with a single script tag and no build step
